content: The official 24h league fields four active strategies across the Timmy and Cosmo & Wanda families, split between Top 20 and Top 50 pair universes. Timmy-Top 50 leads in realized velocity and net PnL with clean v3 telemetry, while both Cosmo & Wanda variants post strong closed-book records but carry significant unrealized drawdowns that drag effective equity below starting capital for the Top 20 incumbent. Timmy-Top 20 offers the tightest drawdown control but minimal alpha generation. Data quality ranges from Clean to Restarted, with tape freshness varying across the field as v3 and v1 versions continue live evaluation.
